analyst.summary: CSB Bank is one of India's oldest private banks, historically known for a gold-loan-heavy lending book, now strategically diversifying into broader retail and wholesale banking. The most recent quarter showed strong growth -- deposits, advances and profit all rising faster than the broader industry -- and bad-loan levels are reportedly at multi-quarter lows. The stock is inexpensive relative to this improving trend, though the promoter's stake has been reduced as part of a standard regulatory requirement for bank promoters. We rate it a Hold: an improving, reasonably priced private bank still mid-way through diversifying its loan book away from a concentrated gold-loan franchise.
